paper_decision.reason: 整体口径仍弱于 sparse 基线，更适合附录或特殊场景分析。

metric_formulas.no_anchor_rate: samples with parser anchor_count=0 and parse_fail=false divided by total samples
metric_formulas.no_anchor_when_gt_changed_rate: samples with at least one GT changed edge (abs(gt-2.0)>0.05) and no_anchor divided by GT-changed samples
metric_formulas.no_anchor_when_gt_target_changed_rate: samples with task-relevant GT target edges (abs(gt-2.0)>2.0) and no_anchor divided by GT-target samples
metric_formulas.target_recall: edge-level recall over GT target edges (abs(gt-2.0)>2.0) using severity-aware hit thresholds
metric_formulas.gt_changed_edge_recall: edge-level recall over all GT changed edges (abs(gt-2.0)>0.05) using sign-aware non-default detection
metric_formulas.MAE_on_changed_edges: absolute error summed only on GT changed edges divided by GT changed edge count
metric_formulas.MAE_on_target_edges: absolute error summed only on GT target edges divided by GT target edge count
metric_formulas.parse_fail_rate_strict: parser parse_fail OR no_anchor on a sample with any GT changed edge, divided by total samples
metric_formulas.dense_weight_mae: legacy dense MAE over all edges after default-2.0 fill, retained only for comparison
